assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only mushoku-tensei:paul@light-novel#character-model, the canonical Paul bounded reconstruction model (generation V1, revision 1.3) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the locked Japanese light novels V01-V12, with direct Paul grounds in V01, V05, the V06 retrospective history (no new present state), the V10 letter and escort deliberation and V12. The model routes its observations to an evidence index, shared state ledger sections, per-volume deep readings and checkpoint syntheses, none of which is curated on this subject or used as evidence here. The project's current-state entrypoint was read for method and gate state only; it records that Paul 1.3 retains its earlier ceiling after the V13-V15 review. No web novel, later light-novel volume, adaptation, performed voice, reception or remembered franchise biography is in scope.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's nine selectors MT-PM-ST01 to ST09: V01 village parent and teacher of an unusually capable son (ST01) and the household crisis and separation, with pre-disaster memories that V05 reveals but that are not new conduct (ST02); V05 post-displacement caregiver and search organizer (ST03), search deterioration and first reunion (ST04) and Geese's correction, second meeting and departure (ST05); the V10 retrospectively disclosed East Port risk decision and letter, with no knowledge of Rudeus's marriage or household and no completed Zenith rescue (ST06); and V12 the Rapan reunion and expedition leadership (ST07), the Zenith sighting, rash assault and revised appeal (ST08) and the second fight, protective action and death (ST09). ST09 is a terminal represented state: nothing after his death, including the imagined grave-side advice, is Paul testimony. He does not know his son's former-life history, and no earlier state acquires later knowledge.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model gives six conditional rules (MT-PM-001 to 006): capability assumptions that lead him to judge before hearing, impose demands and use force; concrete bodily need in a dependent child overriding competing urgency; persistence under shrinking leads followed by drinking and avoidance; resistance, then listening, shame and attempted apology when a trusted person contradicts his father-image; organizing resources while pressing for family unity out of fear of loss; and listener-dependent register. Each has a countercase and a discriminating observation, and the self-concept paragraph (wanting to be a competent father and fearing repeating his own) explains why the same motive can produce correction or imposition. B is not supported because the model records no new equivalent adverse opportunity for rules 001 and 003 in V10, rates mechanism confidence moderate and has only retrospective checks; falsifiable rules with countercases exceed a descriptive profile, so D is not supported.

Nine selectors run from V01 to his death in V12 with per-state knowledge limits: accusation and apology as different knowledge states (ST01), V05 memories of pre-disaster parenting labelled REVEALED_NOT_NEW (ST02), reported, feared and confirmed deaths kept apart (ST03), the V10 decision as historical deliberation newly disclosed rather than present action (ST06) and a terminal represented state with no posthumous speech (ST09). The model also tracks narrow change: the V05 collapse stays historical and the V12 reunion is not a new drunken collapse, while V12 renews force at the maternal-rescue trigger. B is not supported because the selectors are one-line cells citing ledger sections, V06 adds no present state and no selector covers V02-V04, V07-V09 or V11; a sequence with explicit knowledge and leakage limits exceeds an undifferentiated profile, so D is not supported.

Rule 006 and its extensions describe his written speech only in prose: informal joking and blunt commands with familiar men, reassurance with Norn, stiff apology under shame, formal greeting when useful, candid letter advice and a concise request to an escort (V01:010-016, V05:007/009/011/015/020, V10:017/034, V12:001-004/012/014), with the limits that sexual joking can exclude women present, formality is not proof of sincerity and a quiet response must remain possible. It quotes no wording or self-reference and excludes acoustic imitation. Prose-only register description does not support D; the register is affirmatively differentiated by listener, so NOT_ASSESSED would ignore it.

One paragraph lists supported ordinary material: discussing meals, gift plans, arranging a family dinner, professional work, affectionate handling and teasing, and states that it does not establish a universal leisure taste or every domestic habit. No rule governs ordinary behavior; household care appears only through rule 002's concrete need for a sick or frightened child. C is not supported because the domestic material is listed rather than modeled; listed items, which V05 extends with ordinary household memories, exceed a single mention, so E is not supported.

The model makes the recipient a required input and locates differentiated responses: Rudeus as a talented son whose apparent independence activates capability demands, accusation and later embrace and apology (V01:010-011, V12:001/013-014); Norn as a visibly needy daughter who activates concrete care, whose account of his care matters independently and whose acceptance of her brother he cannot command (V05:004-006, V10:017/031/034); Geese as an old companion whose knowledge punctures his assumptions; Zenith and Lilia in a domestic negotiation that gives them agency, with his assault of Lilia kept in the same history; and search members, relatives and specialists as resources he thanks and cannot replace (V05:005/015, V12:011/014). B is not supported because Zenith's and Lilia's inner states are unavailable, Norn's reconciliation is not shown and the later extensions are clauses; differentiated responses across several attested recipients exceed a single relational sketch, so D is not supported.

The model states that V05 adds direct interiority and that D0 DIRECT covers represented interiority, and it uses that access: his fear of repeating his own father, shame and attempted apology after contradiction (V05:004/009/011), his remembered assault of Lilia with retaliatory intent and remorse, and the V10 letter's candid self-knowledge that people change (V10:017/034). B is not supported because direct access concentrates in V05 and the V10 letter, V12 conduct is largely seen through Rudeus, and the model withholds certainty about motives beyond these; a reviewer may weigh it as D. Rendered inner states across several episodes exceed attributed motive alone, so D was not chosen.

Three rules bear on conflict with countercases: rule 001 for judging before hearing and using force (the V01 accusation and blow, V12 rushing at Zenith and grabbing his son with a demand at mortal cost, V12:013-014); rule 003 for the crisis trajectory into drinking and avoidance (V05:005-006/015); and rule 004 for resisting, then hearing correction (V05:009/011). The model also records ignored protest during the V12 expedition and the V12 rashness as a different response from the V05 collapse. B is not supported because the crisis trajectory is one episode, mechanism confidence is moderate and calibration is retrospective; rule-level conflict treatment with countercases exceeds located disputes alone, so D is not supported.

The model locates one disclosed deliberation, the V10 East Port decision in which he weighs escort objections, competing risks and Norn's reliance before delegating her care with money, education and instructions (V10:017/030/034), and morally weighted positions: remorse for the assault, the V12 protective aim pursued by a harmful method and the refusal to let later service vindicate past harm. The last is the model's normative constraint, not his own deliberation. C is not supported because the one weighing is a retrospectively disclosed decision summarized in cells and the other material is positions or acts; located deliberation plus several moral positions exceed a single mention, so E is not supported.

The model names informal joking with familiar men, sexual joking that can exclude women present, teasing as ordinary behavior and V12 banter (V01:010-016, V12:001-004). It gives no content, pattern or rule for humor, so D is not supported; located joking in three volumes is affirmative evidence, so NOT_ASSESSED would ignore it.

One curated item: a compact model (revision 1.3) covering V01, V05, the V06 retrospective, V10 and V12 through six rules, nine selectors and fourteen retrospective checks, with observations routed to an evidence index, shared ledger sections, deep readings and checkpoint syntheses that are not curated on his row. His represented life closes in V12, so the horizon is complete in that sense, but the model declares itself BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL with no clean holdout and names durable sobriety, general noncoercive parenting, unfamiliar political strategy and absent relatives' inner states as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, so C is not supported; systematic coverage of every volume in which he is a direct subject exceeds limited local evidence, so E is not supported.

The model locates affirmative limits and countercases: the V01 accusation and blow, the coercive separation whose necessity is unproved, his assault of Lilia corroborated by her V06 account of resistance and mistrust (V06:030), the V05 drinking collapse and Norn's later recall of fear from his drinking, distinguished from violence against her (V10:031), haste that first harms Norn (V05), sexual joking that excludes women, a first apology that remains stiff until later mediation (MT-PM-V04), ignored protest and the renewed lethal demand in V12 (V12:013-014), and a V01 question about Sylphie's refusal that shows selective listening rather than reflexive force (V01:011). Each limit is a cell or clause and calibration is retrospective with disclosed prior familiarity, so B is not supported; located failures and countercases across four volumes exceed bare gap statements, so D is not supported.

Each selector is bound to a volume and a knowledge state: he never knows his son's former-life history, the V05 pre-disaster memories and V06 history are REVEALED_NOT_NEW, the V10 letter is received at V10 but deliberated earlier, ST06 has no knowledge of Rudeus's marriage or household, and the imagined V12 grave-side advice is barred as Paul testimony. B is not supported because the selectors are one-line labels citing ledger sections, no age is computed and the intervening volumes have no state; D is not supported because knowledge is bounded per state rather than given as a loose period.

scenario_readiness.note: The model characterizes his register only in prose, quotes no wording, excludes acoustic imitation and bars invented Paul testimony, including the imagined grave-side advice. CONDITIONAL would generate speech from a prose register description; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the listener-dependent register the model characterizes.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: Any single named selector MT-PM-ST01 to ST09 between V01 and his death in V12, with that state's knowledge only; no state for V02-V04, V07-V09 or V11, nothing after ST09, no posthumous speech and no knowledge of his son's former life.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Only attested recipients in their state-specific relation: Rudeus as son, Norn as dependent daughter, Zenith and Lilia as spouses within the recorded domestic history, Geese as old companion, relatives and search members as helpers, specialists in the V12 expedition and the escort he instructs in V10.
setting_constraints: The village household, the post-displacement search, the reunion settings, the V10 letter and the V12 expedition of the Japanese light novels
Later care never vindicates the assault of Lilia or earlier force, and remorse is not a guarantee of reform
No clinical diagnosis, assured sobriety, political strategy or later-volume event
Near-analog situations only; materially novel contexts end in abstention

scenario_readiness.note: The model permits D0 represented behavior and only D1 near-analog extension in named parenting, crisis and corrective-conversation contexts, keeps all admitted domains BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL, requires abstention in unsupported contexts and names durable sobriety, general noncoercive parenting, unfamiliar political strategy and absent relatives' inner states as insufficient evidence; calibration is retrospective. His represented life ends in V12, so any scenario after ST09 is invention. CONDITIONAL would extend a near-analog license to materially novel contexts the model declines; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore its explicit application bounds.

Ordinary material is listed in one paragraph (meals, gift plans, a family dinner, professional work, affectionate handling, teasing) with the explicit statement that it establishes no universal leisure taste or domestic habit, and no rule governs it. CONDITIONAL would build ordinary social behavior from a list; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the listed material.

The evidence holds one retrospectively disclosed weighing (the V10 East Port delegation) and several positions and acts, and the model's own normative constraints are not his deliberation. CONDITIONAL would supply moral reasoning the model does not render; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located deliberation and positions.

Spousal relations are in evidence only as a domestic negotiation in which Zenith and Lilia have agency, his assault of Lilia with remorse and her account of resistance and mistrust (V06:030), and the V12 rescue drive for Zenith. The model gives no rule for romantic or marital conduct, withholds his knowledge of Lilia's unspoken insecurity and refuses outputs that assume attractive colleagues are partners. CONDITIONAL would generate spousal or romantic behavior the model does not model and risks vindicating the assault; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located spousal history.

conditions: Only search organization, rescue planning, delegation with resources and expedition leadership in attested Japanese light-novel settings, as near analogs.
His failure modes stay live: shrinking leads can produce withdrawal and drinking, fear of loss can produce pressure for unity, and affect at a family trigger can override judgment, as in V12.
No unfamiliar political strategy, institutional command or guaranteed success, and specialists' expertise is not his.
The selected state's knowledge only; output is behavior described in prose and no quoted speech is generated as canonical.
scenario_readiness.note: The model names observed search leadership among its BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL domains, and rules 003 and 005 locate it: organizing helpers, money and options and warning of political danger (V05:005/012/014-015/020), delegation with resources and instructions (V10:017/030/034) and V12 expedition leadership that waits for specialists and thanks them (V12:006/011/014). Readiness is conditional because the same rules record persistence collapsing into drinking, pressure for unity out of fear of loss and the V12 rash assault when affect overrides judgment, and mechanism confidence is moderate. READY would treat compressed rule cells as a leadership procedure; NOT_READY would deny the search and expedition work the model locates in three volumes.

known_limits.statement: His later care, rescue labor, remorse and protective death never vindicate his assault of Lilia or earlier force; harm and service stay in one history without canceling each other.
Capability assumptions can lead him to judge before hearing, impose demands and use force; this recurs at the V12 maternal-rescue trigger after earlier correction.
Apology, shame and corrected advice are local updates, not durable reform; renewed force in V12 limits any assured permanent change.
The coercive V01 separation is actual and its necessity is unproved; later offered options do not retroactively justify it.
The V05 drinking and avoidance are one crisis trajectory, not a clinical diagnosis or an inevitable response to loss; the V12 reunion is not a new drunken collapse.
He dies in V12; Rudeus's imagined grave-side advice is not Paul testimony, and no posthumous speech or action is in evidence.
Paul never knows his son's former-life history, and his reading of Rudeus's capacity is inference from outward behavior.
His rough familiar diction coexists with apology, reassurance and formality; sexual joking can exclude women present, and formal skill is not proof of sincerity.

All fourteen checks are retrospective fits with disclosed prior franchise familiarity, not clean holdouts or numerical prediction scores; scene confidence is high and mechanism confidence moderate, and no domain is DOMAIN_READY.

The evidence index, shared ledger sections, deep readings and checkpoint syntheses to which the model routes its observations are not curated on this subject, so its locators were not rechecked here and no independent reconstruction test is in the evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.

Durable sobriety, general noncoercive parenting, unfamiliar political strategy, the inner states of absent relatives and leisure beyond the listed items are not established; this is a gap, not evidence of incapacity.
No wording, self-reference or acoustic performance is in evidence; register is described only in prose.
No selector covers V02-V04, V07-V09 or V11; conduct in those periods is not assessed.
